info.title: Dream Interpretation API
info.description:
Dream interpretation API with a 2,000+ symbol dream dictionary and psychological meanings covering animals, objects, emotions, people, scenarios, and abstract concepts. Decode dreams about falling, flying, teeth falling out, being chased, water, snakes, and more. Search, browse A-Z, or discover random symbols. Build dream journal apps, AI dream analysis chatbots, sleep-tracking features, and wellness platforms. One key covers every RoxyAPI domain, with Remote MCP and typed SDKs.

# RoxyAPI: the Spiritual OS layer for agentic AI

> **Base URL:** `https://roxyapi.com/api/v2`. Every path below is relative to it.

One API key for 18 insight domains (Astrology, Vedic Astrology, Forecast, Human Design, Chinese Astrology, Feng Shui, Mesoamerican Astrology, Vastu Shastra, Numerology, Kabbalah, Tarot Reading, Biorhythm, Ayurveda, I-Ching Oracle, Crystals and Healing Stones, Dream Interpretation, Angel Numbers, Location and Timezone), 261+ endpoints, planetary positions verified against NASA JPL Horizons and the calculations held by 2,961 gold standard tests. Readings come back as structured data with editorial interpretation text, translated into 10+ languages via `?lang=` on translated endpoints. Remote MCP servers, typed SDKs for TypeScript, Python, PHP, C#, and Go, drop-in UI components and copy-paste widgets, and open source Templates all run on this one document.

## Who builds on RoxyAPI

- **Developers** shipping astrology, tarot, numerology and wellness apps without learning each system first
- **AI agent builders** giving Claude, GPT or Gemini real calculations instead of guesses, over Remote MCP
- **Vibe coders** building with Cursor, Claude Code, Bolt or Replit from the spec and AGENTS.md
- **Founders and brands** launching insight products for their audience in days instead of months

## Quick start

**1. Get a key** at [roxyapi.com/pricing](https://roxyapi.com/pricing). It is ready the moment payment clears.

**2. Make your first call:**
```bash
curl -H "X-API-Key: YOUR_KEY" https://roxyapi.com/api/v2/astrology/horoscope/aries/daily
```

**3. Check your usage:**
```bash
curl -H "X-API-Key: YOUR_KEY" https://roxyapi.com/api/v2/usage
```

## AI agents: Remote MCP

Every domain has its own Remote MCP server over Streamable HTTP at `https://roxyapi.com/mcp/{domain}` (for example `/mcp/astrology`), 258+ tools in all, with nothing to install or host. Add the URL to Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT or any MCP client, or connect from the OpenAI Agents SDK and Gemini ADK. Coding agents that build against this API use the documentation server at `/mcp/docs`. Setup for every client: [roxyapi.com/docs/mcp](https://roxyapi.com/docs/mcp).

## Authentication

Send your key as `X-API-Key: YOUR_KEY` (recommended), as `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY`, or as the `?api_key=` query parameter for quick tests. Keep secret keys on a server; publishable keys are for the browser.

## Responses and limits

Clean JSON with no wrapper. An error returns `{ "error", "code", "doc_url" }`: `error` is readable and may change wording, `code` is stable and the one to switch on, and `doc_url` links to the fix for that exact code.

Every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Used` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` for your monthly allowance, which resets on the 1st of each month at 00:00 UTC. Each plan also has a per-minute limit for bursts, from 600 requests per minute on Starter; going over it answers `429` with a `Retry-After` and never counts against the month.

## Errors

Every code the API returns, also published machine-readably as `x-error-codes` on the `info` object of this document:

| Status | Code | When |
|--------|------|------|
| 400 | [`validation_error`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#validation_error) | A field is missing or invalid. The body lists every failing field at once in issues, each with its path and the expected shape. |
| 400 | [`bad_request`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#bad_request) | The request was rejected as a whole, for example a body that is not valid JSON or a date range that ends before it starts. |
| 401 | [`api_key_required`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#api_key_required) | No API key was sent. |
| 401 | [`invalid_api_key`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#invalid_api_key) | The key sent is malformed or cannot be verified. |
| 401 | [`api_key_revoked`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#api_key_revoked) | The key was valid once and has since been revoked from the account page. |
| 401 | [`subscription_not_found`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#subscription_not_found) | The key verifies, but the subscription behind it no longer exists. |
| 401 | [`subscription_inactive`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#subscription_inactive) | The subscription behind the key is cancelled, expired or suspended, or a trial is past its end date. |
| 401 | [`publishable_key_not_allowed_on_mcp`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#publishable_key_not_allowed_on_mcp) | A publishable key was used on a Remote MCP server, which takes a secret key. |
| 401 | [`invalid_client_ip`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#invalid_client_ip) | A keyless request could not be attributed to a caller. |
| 401 | [`unauthorized`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#unauthorized) | Authentication failed with no more specific reason to give. |
| 403 | [`forbidden`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#forbidden) | The key is valid, but this request is not permitted. |
| 403 | [`origin_required`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#origin_required) | A publishable key with an origin allowlist was used with no Origin header, as from a server or a native app. |
| 403 | [`origin_not_allowed`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#origin_not_allowed) | The calling site is not on the origin allowlist of this publishable key. |
| 404 | [`not_found`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#not_found) | Nothing is served at this path, or the identifier in it does not exist. A path miss adds suggestions, the closest real endpoints. |
| 405 | [`method_not_allowed`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#method_not_allowed) | The path exists for a different HTTP method. The body lists the accepted methods in allow, as does the Allow header. |
| 409 | [`conflict`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#conflict) | The request cannot be applied in the current state. |
| 410 | [`gone`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#gone) | The path was removed permanently. |
| 413 | [`payload_too_large`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#payload_too_large) | The request body is larger than the API accepts. |
| 415 | [`unsupported_media_type`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#unsupported_media_type) | A request with a body was sent without Content-Type: application/json. |
| 422 | [`unprocessable_entity`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#unprocessable_entity) | Every field is valid, but the combination cannot be computed. |
| 429 | [`rate_limit_exceeded`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#rate_limit_exceeded) | The monthly request allowance is used up. Retry-After gives the seconds to the reset. |
| 429 | [`rate_limit_per_minute`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#rate_limit_per_minute) | The per-minute limit of the plan was reached. Retry-After gives the seconds to the next minute, and the monthly allowance is not charged. |
| 429 | [`rate_limited`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#rate_limited) | A rate limit was reached, reported without the plan detail. |
| 429 | [`free_tier_exhausted`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#free_tier_exhausted) | A keyless request has used up its trial allowance. |
| 500 | [`internal_error`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#internal_error) | The request failed inside our service. Retry with exponential backoff. |
| 503 | [`compute_saturated`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#compute_saturated) | Heavy calculations are briefly at capacity. Send the same request again after Retry-After seconds. |
| Any | [`error`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#error) | A fallback for a status with no more specific code. The status and the error field carry the signal. |

## Pricing

One flat subscription covers every domain, every endpoint, Remote MCP, the SDKs, UI components, widgets and every language. Every call counts the same, a planet position or a full birth chart, with no credits and no per-product fees. From $39 per month for 50K requests, up to 3M requests, with custom volume above that: [roxyapi.com/pricing](https://roxyapi.com/pricing).

## Resources

- [Quickstart](https://roxyapi.com/docs/quickstart): the first call in 60 seconds
- [Documentation](https://roxyapi.com/docs): guides, tutorials and a reference per domain
- [Remote MCP](https://roxyapi.com/docs/mcp): connect an AI agent
- [SDKs](https://roxyapi.com/docs/sdk) and [UI components](https://roxyapi.com/ui)
- [Templates](https://roxyapi.com/templates): open source apps to clone and deploy
- [Methodology](https://roxyapi.com/methodology): how accuracy is verified
- [Contact](https://roxyapi.com/contact): support and key recovery

get.summary: List and search dream symbols - Dream dictionary API
get.description: Browse and search our complete dream interpretation dictionary containing 2,000+ dream symbols with psychological meanings. Find dream meanings for animals (snake dreams, spider dreams, dog dreams), common scenarios (falling dreams, flying dreams, being chased, drowning), people (dreams about mother, father, baby, ex), objects (car, house, water, fire), emotions (fear, anxiety, love), body parts (teeth falling out, hair, eyes), colors, numbers, and abstract concepts. Filter by starting letter for A-Z navigation or search by keyword to find what your dreams mean.

post.summary: Daily dream symbol - Dream symbol of the day API
post.description: Receive a single dream symbol for daily reflection and subconscious exploration. Uses seeded randomness so the same seed gets the same symbol on the same day, perfect for "Dream Symbol of the Day" features. Provide a seed (userId, email hash, session token) for reproducible consistency, or omit for date-based daily symbols. Returns the symbol with full psychological interpretation. Great for dream journal apps, wellness platforms, morning ritual apps, and meditation tools.

seed.description: Optional seed for reproducible readings. Same seed + same date = same symbol every time. Pass any unique identifier (userId, email hash, session token). Omit for anonymous daily readings.

date.description: Date for the reading in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today (UTC). Useful for viewing past daily readings or pre-generating future ones.
Date of the daily dream symbol in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC). Determines which symbol is selected for seeded readings.

seed.description: Seed used for this daily reading. Same seed on the same date always produces the identical symbol.

id.description: Unique symbol identifier in kebab-case. Use this to fetch full details via /symbols/{id}.

name.description: Display name of the dream symbol.

meaning.example: Flying dreams can be the most exhilarating, liberating and instantly gratifying dreams you can ever have. These dreams are classified as lucid, suggesting that the dreamer is aware that they are dreaming.
meaning.description: Full psychological dream interpretation explaining the subconscious symbolism, emotional significance, and waking-life connections.

dailyMessage.example: Your dream symbol for 2026-01-28: Flying. Flying dreams can be the most exhilarating, liberating and instantly gratifying dreams you can ever have...
dailyMessage.description: Concise daily message summarizing the dream symbol and its key themes for quick reflection.
